name: Citadines Connect Cecil Georgetown Penang
detail: A great little hotel with a strategic location, although it’s slightly on the outskirts of Georgetown. The rooms and overall space are compact, but everything is thoughtfully designed, modern, and well-equipped with complete facilities. Perfect for travelers who appreciate comfort, convenience, and modern amenities without needing a huge hotel room. Definitely a great stay in Penang!

name: Jazz Hotel Penang
detail: This was my first time booking at this hotel and my experience was very satisfying. The hotel staff were very friendly and provided excellent service to all guests, even those who were not VIPs. The room was comfortable, clean, and spacious. Although my room did not have an iron, I just had to call the hotel number to request one, and they sent an iron to my room right away. It was very convenient. For Muslim guests, there is a suitable space for prayers and a qibla direction marker on the ceiling. Parking inside the building is also easy and very convenient. The only slight improvement that could be made is regarding the Wi-Fi. Perhaps due to many guests using the Wi-Fi at the same time, the speed was somewhat slow. I hope the hotel can further enhance the quality and speed of the Wi-Fi in the future. I hope the hotel can continue to maintain the cleanliness of the rooms and the quality of service as it is now. Highly recommended and I will definitely come again!

name: Collection O Batu Ferringhi Beach formerly ESQ Ferringhi
detail: Cozy beds, spacious room, and awesome staff. We laughed through every photo attempt!

name: Hotel Penaga
detail: Penang self-service hotel 🏨 share [smirk R] A friend recommended it to me 😄 it's really great The reception and staff are quite nice [laugh out loud R] No deposit required, breakfast included, there’s a drinking water dispenser As a water buffalo 🐃 this is very important The room is super spacious, has a bathtub and is very clean The key point is that it has a strong Nanyang style, the decor is exquisite You can even take direct photos [smirk R] Very exquisite, also has a bathtub 🛀 There’s a sofa 🛋️ so the child can sleep separately without disturbance Great geographical location, just a short walk to the pedestrian street But it’s also very quiet at night 🤫 The air conditioning is powerful! There’s also a ceiling fan There’s a small fridge, it's a bit old but when it starts it sounds like a bomber plane [smirk R] It’s fine for storing some unfinished sweet soup Only a five to ten minute walk to mural street, Peranakan Museum, and Shantou Street night market Markets, police station, haha Wanxiang pastry shop and Beryl’s chocolate are also nearby! In summary, it’s really nice.

name: lyf Georgetown Penang
detail: It is conveniently located for both dining and sightseeing, and the hotel is clean and quiet. The staff is friendly. There is a 24-hour nasi kandar within walking distance, and you can get there almost without getting wet even if it rains. The bakery at the back also has a nice atmosphere. The traffic on the roads around the hotel is heavy, so be cautious if you have small children. Overall, I will definitely return.

name: The Prestige Hotel Penang, a Member of Design Hotels
detail: It's just a short distance from the ferry terminal. The staff were all smiling and very courteous. I enjoyed a welcome drink with wine, which was quite nice. The rooms, like the building, have a white base and feel clean and stylish. Bathrobes are also provided, which adds to the comfort. My room had a round table, making it convenient for using my computer or having tea, and I could relax well. I also used the infinity pool in the afternoon. Bath towels were provided, and I was able to spend time leisurely enjoying the view. (There isn’t a changing area, so I needed to change in my room before going.) When I needed to go somewhere a bit farther away, I used Grab, but there is also Little India within walking distance from the hotel, where I enjoyed delicious Indian food, and there were plenty of places like food courts for breakfast, so I had no trouble finding places to eat. I think those who don’t mind walking can also go see the street art on foot.

name: Cititel Express Penang Hotel
detail: The experience of this stay was very satisfying. The hotel is in a great location, with restaurants, convenience stores, and transportation stations nearby, making travel convenient. The room was very clean, with fresh air, a soft and comfortable bed, and the pillow height was just right; I slept very soundly. The staff were very friendly, whether at the front desk during check-in or providing local information, they were patient and thorough, making one feel very cared for. The hotel facilities were also very complete, with plenty of hot water, quiet air conditioning, and fast internet speed. The overall atmosphere was very quiet, allowing for true relaxation and rest. When leaving, I even felt a bit reluctant to go; I will choose this place again next time and will also recommend it to friends.

name: Areca Hotel Penang
detail: I was able to spend a wonderful time. The building has a design that feels historical, and the interior was very clean and comfortable. The room was spacious, with a calm atmosphere that allowed me to relax. The location was also very convenient, as I could walk to tourist spots, restaurants, and souvenir shops in Georgetown. The atmosphere of the breakfast venue was also very lovely, and I was able to enjoy a leisurely time there. The staff was kind, making my stay very pleasant. I really liked it, so I definitely want to stay again the next time I visit Penang.

name: Amari SPICE Penang
detail: Excellent location for those attending events in Setia Spice Penang convention centre!

name: Kimberley Hotel Georgetown
detail: Close to Komta and with the bus terminal nearby, you can reach almost all the tourist spots in the area by following the signs to the CAT pickup point. If it gets too hot and tiring, you can quickly return to the Kimball Hotel. Other than Gurney, I did not use Grab. It was known in advance that there is no refrigerator in the room, but given the price and the conditions, it's not a problem at all. There's also a convenience store nearby, and a coin laundry right next door, making it very convenient.
